data.name: Cataldo
data.gender_notes: Cataldo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'Catalaus', meaning old or aged, and the Italian 'Dal', meaning from. The name Cataldo is of Italian and Biblical origin and is a masculine name. It is a name that signifies wisdom and strength. In the Bible, Cataldo is the name of a 14th-century Italian saint. The name Cataldo carries the meaning “Old, Brave, Man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Cataldo usually hope their child will grow to embody old, brave, man and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: קאטאלדו הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו באיטלקית ופירושו 'כל טוב'. השם קאטאלדו נגזר מהמילים האיטלקיות 'cata' שפירושה 'כל' ו-'aldo' שפירושה 'טוב'. השם קשור לקדוש הנוצרי קאטאלדו, שהיה איש כנסייה איטלקי מהמאה ה-10.

in_greek.name: Κατάλδο
in_greek.long_meaning: Κατάλδο είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα ελληνικής προέλευσης, που σημαίνει 'καλός' ή 'αγαθός'. Το όνομα Κατάλδο προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'κατά' που σημαίνει 'κάτω' ή 'προς' και 'αλδός' που σημαίνει 'καλός' ή 'αγαθός'. Ο Άγιος Κατάλδο ήταν ένας χριστιανός άγιος του 10ου αιώνα στην Ιταλία.

in_latin.name: Cataldus
in_latin.long_meaning: Cataldus est nomen Christianum quod significat 'bonus' vel 'optimus'. Nomen Cataldus derivatur ex Italicis verbis 'cata' quod significat 'omnis' et 'aldo' quod significat 'bonus'. Sanctus Cataldus fuit ecclesiae Italicae saeculi X.

The name Cataldo symbolizes spiritual goodness, kindness, and generosity.

Many Italian immigrants brought the name with them to America, and it was often used for their children. In some areas of Italy, particularly in the southern region, the name is still in use today.

Saint Cataldo is the patron saint of Sicily, Italy, and is believed to have performed numerous miracles throughout his life. He is particularly known for his healing powers and is often invoked for healing physical ailments and spiritual distress. The name Cataldo serves as a reminder of the power of faith, hope, and wisdom in overcoming life's challenges.

The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.
